## Fieldset.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `legend` :: Group heading rendered inside `<legend>`.
- `description` :: Supporting explanation shown below the legend.
- `error` :: Validation error displayed underneath the group fields.
- `surface` :: Container surface style on the shared surface axis.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the group's frame and border, from `rect` to fully rounded. @default 'modern'
- `gap` :: Spacing between group sections on the shared gap ladder.
- `pad` :: The group's inner padding on the shared pad ladder.
- `textSize` :: The legend's text scale.
- `textColor` :: The legend's text colour.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the description and the error, which follow `textSize` when omitted.
- `childTextColor` :: The colour of the description and the error. Left unset it keeps the pair: secondary description, danger error.
- `disabled` :: Natively disables all descendant form controls.
- `invalid` :: Marks the group invalid even without an inline `error` string.
- `children` :: Form fields inside the group.
- `footer` :: Optional action or summary footer below fields.
